parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by Stores whose name contains this value. The match is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Filter by Store management status. When omitted, both active and inactive Stores are returned.

parameters.name: conceptStoreId
parameters.description: Filter by the Stores assigned to this Concept Store.

parameters.name: storeAreaId
parameters.description: Filter by the Stores assigned to this Store Area.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Related data to embed in each Store. Omit to receive only the Store's own fields.

items.description: Related data that can be embedded in a Store response through the `include` parameter.
items.title: Stores.StoreInclude

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don’t include this parameter on the first call. Use the `nextStart` value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.
